question: Where can I get the list of grid connection requests in Germany, with project, technology, capacity (MW), connection node, status and date?

answer.summary: Germany publishes no open nationwide list of grid connection requests; applications (Netzanschlussbegehren) are tracked bilaterally per applicant. Under § 9 KraftNAV, >=110 kV operators keep a joint Kraftwerksanschluss-Register (via BDEW) for >=100 MW generation (excluding storage since 2025-12-23), restricted to eligible applicants and authorities; only TenneT posted an open 2020-02-18 PDF (93 entries: 8 requests, 8 commitments) lacking request dates. Current 2025-2026 releases (BNetzA/SMARD battery survey, 50Hertz 75-node API) give only aggregates where DSO respondent counts, net/gross MW basis and bidirectional storage double-counting must be inferred.
main_caveats: No open request queue exists: under EnWG § 17, EU Reg. 2019/943 Art. 50(4a) and BT-Drs. 21/7866 (§ 17d EnWG-E), operators report request status bilaterally to applicants, not in a public register.

§ 9 KraftNAV covers only generation >=100 MW at >=110 kV for eligible applicants/regulators, and since 2025-12-23 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 368) expressly excludes battery storage, where most new queue volume sits.

SMARD counted 18,158 new battery requests in 2025 (573.5 GW, including duplicates by project). Of these, 1,468 received offers in 2025 (33.9 GW). The 1,937 offers issued in 2025 (54.2 GW) also include older requests.

BNetzA/SMARD omits the DSO respondent count and net/gross MW basis; cross-checking Monitoringbericht 2026 p. 96 implies 4 TSOs and up to 813 of 851 DSOs reported in 2025, not all 842 DSOs registered in 2026.

50Hertz's live 75-node API sums requestedGenerationCapacityMw (59.8 GW) and requestedLoadCapacityMw (67.7 GW); both match at 40 nodes, implying bidirectional storage is counted in both (summing to 128 GW double-counts).
answer.confidence_reason: Verified directly in EnWG, KraftNAV (incl. 2025-12-23 amendment), MaStRV, BT-Drs. 21/7866, EU 2024/1747 & 2024/1711, BNetzA/SMARD, all 4 TSOs, VNBdigital, GovData, GridChecker, and 10 sampled DSOs.

attributes.note: TenneT's 2020 KraftNAV PDF names >=100 MW generation projects/operators in its zone; the live § 9 KraftNAV register is restricted and non-KraftNAV queues are unpublished.
attributes.gap_note: Under § 9 Satz 3 KraftNAV, the live joint Kraftwerksanschluss-Register (>=100 MW generation at >=110 kV) is disclosed only to eligible applicants (Anschlussnehmer) and regulatory/supervisory authorities. Connection requests for battery storage (excluded from KraftNAV since 2025-12-23), demand (data centres, electrolysers, industry), plants <100 MW, and <110 kV distribution grids are handled bilaterally and not published as project lists by BNetzA, the 4 TSOs, or sampled DSOs.

attributes.note: TenneT's 2020 KraftNAV PDF lists Primärenergieträger per >=100 MW entry; live § 9 KraftNAV access is restricted and storage/demand/DSO request technologies are unpublished.
attributes.gap_note: TenneT's static 2020-02-18 KraftNAV register reports Primärenergieträger (Erdgas, Steinkohle, Wind offshore, Pumpspeicher, Kernkraft) for >=100 MW generation in its zone. Live access to the BDEW-coordinated § 9 KraftNAV register is restricted to Anschlussnehmer and authorities, and neither BNetzA nor TSOs/sampled DSOs publish per-request technology records for battery storage, renewables <100 MW, or large loads.

attributes.note: TenneT's 2020 PDF reports gross Nennleistung in MW (brutto) per >=100 MW entry; live § 9 KraftNAV data are restricted and 2025-2026 releases give only node or national sums.
attributes.gap_note: Individual requested MW is public only in TenneT's frozen 2020-02-18 KraftNAV PDF (>=100 MW gross generation) and restricted in the live § 9 KraftNAV register. Current 2025-2026 public sources (50Hertz's 75-substation JSON API and BNetzA/SMARD battery surveys) publish only substation-summed or national GW aggregates, and BNetzA § 31 EnWG dispute decisions redact requested MW as business secrets.

attributes.note: TenneT's 2020 PDF names Netzanschlusspunkt (UW) per >=100 MW entry without flagging requested vs assigned; live § 9 KraftNAV is restricted and other queues omit per-request nodes.
attributes.gap_note: TenneT's 2020-02-18 PDF lists a substation, offshore platform, or area (e.g. UW Simbach, OSS Austerngrund, Raum Stade) without explicitly flagging requested versus operator-assigned nodes. Live § 9 KraftNAV site/grid data are restricted to Anschlussnehmer and authorities; 50Hertz's public JSON API reports only summed MW per substation, while Amprion, TransnetBW, TenneT, and sampled DSOs publish no per-request node assignments.

attributes.note: TenneT's 2020 PDF codes request/commitment/expired stages without queue rank; live § 9 KraftNAV is restricted and TSO/DSO queue or Reifegrad scores are bilateral only.
attributes.gap_note: TenneT's 2020-02-18 PDF distinguishes 4 Anschussbegehren [sic], 5 Anschlusszusage, and 6 Begehren/Zusage aufgegeben oder verfallen, but omits queue rank. Live § 9 KraftNAV entries are restricted; under EnWG § 17, EU Reg. 2019/943 Art. 50(4a), and the 4-TSO Reifegradverfahren (launched 2026-04-01), processing status and queue/maturity ranks are communicated bilaterally to each applicant.

attributes.note: No public German source gives application, acceptance or commitment dates per request; TenneT's 2020 KraftNAV PDF leaves erste Einspeisung blank for all pending/committed rows.
attributes.gap_note: Checked § 9 KraftNAV, TenneT's 2020-02-18 Kraftwerksanschlussregister PDF (which includes only an erste Einspeisung column for operating plants and omits application/commitment dates on all status 4 and 5 rows), BNetzA/SMARD, all 4 TSOs, and 10 sampled DSOs. Request and decision dates surface only for single disputed projects in BNetzA § 31 EnWG rulings or municipal B-Plan filings.

attributes.note: Public request-level data stop at TenneT's 2020-02-18 KraftNAV PDF (6+ years stale); current § 9 KraftNAV records are restricted and 2025-2026 public releases are aggregates.
attributes.gap_note: No current public request-level release exists on BNetzA, TSO, or sampled DSO portals as of 2026-11-26; TenneT's open PDF is dated 2020-02-18, whereas current § 9 KraftNAV records (>=100 MW generation excluding storage) are restricted to eligible applicants and authorities.

attributes.note: Only a single frozen 2020-02-18 PDF snapshot from TenneT was found; neither BNetzA nor grid operators publish historical archives of itemized connection-request records.
attributes.gap_note: Checked BNetzA, SMARD, netztransparenz.de, all 4 TSOs, GovData, Capacitypedia, and GridChecker. TenneT exposes only one static 2020-02-18 PDF; SMARD (2024-2026) and GridChecker (Oct 2024-Nov 2026) archive only national or substation-level MW aggregates, not request-level histories.

attributes.note: Neither § 9 KraftNAV nor TenneT states an update schedule for request-level registers, and TenneT's open PDF has not been refreshed since 2020-02-18.
attributes.gap_note: § 9 KraftNAV defines no publication cadence for the Kraftwerksanschluss-Register. Monthly map updates (Art. 50(4a) Reg. (EU) 2019/943; § 17c EnWG-E) and 10-month 4-TSO Reifegradverfahren cycles cover hosting capacity, while at-least-quarterly request status updates go bilaterally to applicants rather than a public list.

sources.summary: Static 2020-02-18 PDF extract of TenneT Germany's § 9 KraftNAV power-plant connection register (>=100 MW generation at >=110 kV).
sources.coverage_note: 93 register entries in TenneT's German zone: 8 pending connection requests (3,101 MW), 8 connection commitments (3,327 MW), 23 expired/withdrawn requests, 35 operating, 14 retired/mothballed, and 5 reserve units.
caveats: Frozen at 2020-02-18 with no request or commitment dates; covers only >=100 MW generation in TenneT's zone.
Status 4 is misspelled '4 Anschussbegehren' in the PDF, and capacities include strings like '2 x 480'.

coverage.geographic: TenneT TSO GmbH German control area (onshore 220/380 kV across Schleswig-Holstein, Lower Saxony, Bremen, parts of NRW, Hesse, Bavaria, and North Sea AWZ 155 kV offshore connections)

unit.value: Gross nominal electrical capacity in megawatts (Nennleistung in MW (brutto)) and grid voltage in kilovolts (Spannungsebene in kV).

inclusion_rule.value: Electricity generation plants with nominal capacity >=100 MW connected or requesting connection to grids >=110 kV under §§ 1 and 9 KraftNAV (existing, mothballed, decommissioned, requested, committed, and expired/withdrawn).

attempts.note: PDF states only 'Stand 18.02.2020' with no update schedule; no newer KW-Register PDF was found on netztransparenz.tennet.eu or tennet.eu.
Capacitypedia's TenneT Germany profile reports 'Information published for volumes of connection requests/waiting lines: No'.

exclusions.value: Excludes all plants <100 MW, all grids <110 kV, all demand connections, all other German TSOs/DSOs, and (under § 1 Abs. 1 Satz 2 KraftNAV as amended 2025-12-23) energy storage facilities.
exclusions.quote: Diese Verordnung regelt Bedingungen für den Netzanschluss von Anlagen zur Erzeugung von elektrischer Energie (Erzeugungsanlagen) mit einer Nennleistung ab 100 Megawatt an Elektrizitätsversorgungsnetze mit einer Spannung von mindestens 110 Kilovolt. Die Verordnung findet keine Anwendung auf Energiespeicheranlagen im Sinne des § 3 Nummer 36 des Energiewirtschaftsgesetzes.

key_fields.meaning: Operator register entry identifier (7555 - 001 to 7555 - 099, with 6 numbers absent; 93 rows total)
Site name and municipality/street address or 'Nordsee, AWZ' for offshore wind farms
Power plant unit or project name
Commissioning year/month (or Excel serial integer) for operating plants; blank on pending request and commitment rows
Plant operator or applicant company (left blank on several offshore status-4 rows)
Primary energy carrier / technology (Erdgas, Steinkohle, Kernkraft, Pumpspeicher, Wind offshore)
Gross nominal capacity in MW (sometimes written as multi-unit expressions such as '2 x 480')
Substation (UW), offshore converter/platform (OSS), or area ('Raum Stade') without distinguishing requested vs assigned

Coded stage: 1 Bestand (35), 2 vorübergehend stillgelegt (4), 3 endgültig aufgegeben (10), 4 Anschussbegehren (8), 5 Anschlusszusage (8), 6 Begehren/Zusage aufgegeben oder verfallen (23), plus 5 grid-reserve rows

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sL --max-time 60 -o /tmp/tennet_kw_register.pdf "https://netztransparenz.tennet.eu/fileadmin/user_upload/The_Electricity_Market/German_Market/Grid_customers/kraftnav/2020-02_18_TTG_7555_KW-Register.pdf" && pdftotext -layout /tmp/tennet_kw_register.pdf - | grep -E "4 Ansch|5 Anschlusszusage" | head -n 2 | sed -E "s/  +/ | /g"
how_to_use.example_result:
7555 | - 007 | Haiming | Burghausen | KW Haiming | OMV Power International | Erdgas | 2 x 480 | 380 | TenneT TSO GmbH | UW Simbach | 5 Anschlusszusage
7555 - 074 | OWP Austerngrund | Nordsee, AWZ | OWP Austerngrund | x | Wind offshore | 400 | 155 | TenneT TSO GmbH | OSS Austerngrund | 4 Anschussbegehren
steps: Download the 6-page PDF directly from netztransparenz.tennet.eu (no login or custom headers required; note that www.tennet.eu's main HTML pages return HTTP 403 to non-browser clients).
Extract fixed-width rows with 'pdftotext -layout' and match lines starting with register prefix '7555 -'; merge wrapped two-line offshore wind rows (e.g. 7555 - 063, 7555 - 076, 7555 - 082).

Filter the Status column for '4 Anschussbegehren' (8 open connection requests, 3,101 MW gross) and '5 Anschlusszusage' (8 active connection commitments, 3,327 MW gross), separating them from '1 Bestand' (35 operating plants) and '6 Begehren/Zusage aufgegeben oder verfallen' (23 expired/withdrawn requests).
Parse multi-block strings in 'Nennleistung in MW (brutto)' such as '2 x 480' or '5 x 202,7' (German decimal comma) into numeric MW.
reading_traps: Typo in status label: pending connection requests are spelled '4 Anschussbegehren' (missing 'l') throughout the PDF, so exact-string filters for 'Anschlussbegehren' miss all 8 pending requests.

93 rows represent all § 9 KraftNAV lifecycle states (operating, retired, reserve, expired, committed, requested), NOT 93 open requests; only 8 rows are open requests (Status 4) and 8 are commitments (Status 5).
Multi-unit capacity strings ('2 x 480', '2 x 202,7') and German decimal commas appear in the MW column; naive float parsing fails or reads '2' instead of 960 MW.
Several date cells in 'erste Einspeisung' contain raw Excel serial integers ('43800', '42736') for commissioned offshore wind farms, while all Status 4 and Status 5 rows have no date at all.
Kraftwerksbetreiber is blank on 7 of the 8 Status 4 offshore wind rows, and the file is frozen at 2020-02-18 (many 2020 offshore rows were superseded by WindSeeG tenders).

problems: TenneT's current customer landing page on www.tennet.eu returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to automated HTTP clients, whereas the legacy netztransparenz.tennet.eu file host serves the 2020 PDF with HTTP 200.

sources.publisher: German >=110 kV electricity network operators (coordinated via BDEW Bundesverband der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft e.V.)
sources.format: Operator/BDEW register disclosure upon eligible applicant or authority request (format not publicly standardized)

sources.adds: Provides the legally mandated current nationwide register of >=100 MW generation connection requests across all 4 TSOs and >=110 kV DSOs, accessible upon request to eligible grid-connection applicants and authorities.
sources.summary: Statutory joint register of >=100 MW generation plants and formal connection requests at >=110 kV across Germany under § 9 KraftNAV, coordinated via BDEW.
sources.coverage_note: Covers >=110 kV operators within Germany's 846 registered electricity network operators (4 TSOs + 842 DSOs in 2026; 14 tested); restricted to eligible >=100 MW generation applicants and authorities.
caveats: Not open to the general public (§ 9 Satz 3 KraftNAV) and excludes all energy storage since 2025-12-23, demand, <100 MW plants, and <110 kV grids.
Operator KraftNAV webpages publish § 3 forms and schematic maps rather than the § 9 register itself.

coverage.geographic: Germany (all >=110 kV transmission and high-voltage distribution networks)

unit.value: Generation plants >=100 MW nominal electrical capacity (Nennleistung ab 100 Megawatt) at >=110 kV.
unit.quote: Diese Verordnung regelt Bedingungen für den Netzanschluss von Anlagen zur Erzeugung von elektrischer Energie (Erzeugungsanlagen) mit einer Nennleistung ab 100 Megawatt an Elektrizitätsversorgungsnetze mit einer Spannung von mindestens 110 Kilovolt.

inclusion_rule.value: All existing >=100 MW generation plants at >=110 kV, all >=100 MW generation plants with a formal connection request under § 3 Abs. 2 KraftNAV, and permanently/non-temporarily shut down plant sites.
inclusion_rule.quote: Die Netzbetreiber haben ein gemeinsames Register aller Erzeugungsanlagen, die bestehen oder für die ein Netzanschlussbegehren nach § 3 Abs. 2 vorliegt, und eine übersichtliche Darstellung des Netzschemaplans und der Netzauslastung, einschließlich der Kennzeichnung bestehender oder erwarteter Engpässe zu führen.

attempts.note: § 9 KraftNAV requires continuous maintenance by operators ('zu führen') but publishes no public timestamp.
NRM Netzdienste confirms entries are recorded in the BDEW-maintained Kraftwerksanschluss-Register without exposing a public snapshot date.

§ 3 Abs. 1 Nr. 3 KraftNAV requires a 'laufend aktualisierte' grid schematic/utilization view on operator websites, whereas § 9 KraftNAV specifies no public update interval for the Kraftwerksanschluss-Register.
BDEW's public website exposes no open login or update schedule for the § 9 KraftNAV register.

exclusions.value: Restricted to Anschlussnehmer (>=100 MW generation applicants at >=110 kV) and regulatory/supervisory authorities; excludes energy storage facilities since 2025-12-23 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 368), demand connections, generation <100 MW, and <110 kV grids.
exclusions.quote: Die Daten sind Anschlussnehmern sowie auf Anforderung den Energieaufsichtsbehörden und Regulierungsbehörden in geeigneter Form zur Verfügung zu stellen.

key_fields.meaning: Existing >=100 MW plants, formal >=100 MW connection requests, and mothballed or permanently closed power-plant sites
Plant locations recorded in the joint operator register
Schematic >=110 kV network plan and grid utilization marking existing or expected bottlenecks

steps: Verify project eligibility under §§ 1 and 2 Nr. 1 KraftNAV: only project developers, builders, or operators claiming a >=110 kV grid connection for an electricity generation plant >=100 MW (excluding energy storage under § 1 Abs. 1 Satz 2 KraftNAV) qualify as Anschlussnehmer.

Submit a formal request for § 9 KraftNAV Kraftwerksanschluss-Register access (and, once in examination under § 3 Abs. 3, § 5 KraftNAV load-flow assumptions) to the relevant TSO or >=110 kV DSO connection contact (e.g. netzanschluss-anfragen-antraege@50hertz.com, netzanschluss@amprion.net, netzanschlussanfragen@tennet.eu, netzzugang@transnetbw.de).
Note that third-party researchers without an eligible >=100 MW generation project are not entitled to inspection under § 9 Satz 3 KraftNAV.
reading_traps: Battery storage is excluded: since 2025-12-23 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 368), § 1 Abs. 1 Satz 2 KraftNAV excludes Energiespeicheranlagen, as confirmed in BNetzA decision BK6-25-298 (2026-08-05).

Operator 'Veröffentlichungen nach KraftNAV' pages satisfy § 3 Abs. 1 KraftNAV (minimum application requirements, model contracts, simplified 110-380 kV schematic maps) and almost never publish the § 9 register itself.

Of the 846 electricity network operators registered with BNetzA in 2026 (4 TSOs + 842 DSOs), most municipal DSOs operate only <=20 kV networks and fall outside KraftNAV's >=110 kV operator definition (§ 2 Nr. 3 KraftNAV).

problems: Statutory access restriction under § 9 Satz 3 KraftNAV limits disclosure of the live register to eligible >=100 MW generation applicants (Anschlussnehmer) and regulatory/supervisory authorities; three sampled DSO portals (Bayernwerk, Westnetz, E.DIS) also block automated HTTP clients with HTTP 403.

evidence.claim: § 9 KraftNAV mandates a joint register including >=100 MW connection requests under § 3 Abs. 2, disclosed to Anschlussnehmer and authorities rather than the general public.
evidence.quote: Die Netzbetreiber haben ein gemeinsames Register aller Erzeugungsanlagen, die bestehen oder für die ein Netzanschlussbegehren nach § 3 Abs. 2 vorliegt, und eine übersichtliche Darstellung des Netzschemaplans und der Netzauslastung, einschließlich der Kennzeichnung bestehender oder erwarteter Engpässe zu führen.

evidence.claim: 110 kV DSOs submit their § 9 KraftNAV entries into the joint Kraftwerksanschluss-Register maintained by BDEW rather than publishing open request lists.
evidence.quote: Aus diesem Grund hat die NRM Eintragungen von Kraftwerksstandorten in dem vom BDEW Bundesverband der Energie-und Wasserwirtschaft e.V. geführten Kraftwerksanschluss-Registers vorzunehmen.

evidence.claim: Applicants in TSO connection proceedings must specifically request disclosure of Kraftwerksanschluss-Register data from the TSO.
evidence.quote: Zudem beantragte die Antragstellerin die Zurverfügungstellung von Netzdaten aus dem Kraftwerksanschluss-Register.

publication_obligation.norm: § 17 EnWG; §§ 3, 9 KraftNAV (amended by BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 368); Art. 50(4a) Regulation (EU) 2019/943 (amended by (EU) 2024/1747); Art. 31(3) Directive (EU) 2019/944 (amended by (EU) 2024/1711); Draft §§ 17a-17f EnWG-E (BT-Drs. 21/7866)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: No law requires public itemized connection-request lists: Art. 50(4a) Reg. (EU) 2019/943 requires TSOs to publish available capacity including aggregate capacity under connection request (respecting confidentiality), § 17c EnWG-E (BT-Drs. 21/7866) mandates monthly HV/MV hosting-capacity maps, § 9 KraftNAV restricts the >=100 MW generation register to Anschlussnehmer and authorities, and Art. 50(4a) / Art. 31(3) / § 17d EnWG-E require status updates only bilaterally to the applicant.
publication_obligation.frequency: Monthly for available hosting-capacity maps (Art. 50(4a) Reg. (EU) 2019/943; draft § 17c EnWG-E); at least quarterly bilateral request-status updates to the applicant only.

consolidated_republication.note: No authority republishes an itemized national queue. BNetzA republishes only annual/ad-hoc national TSO vs DSO aggregate counts and GW/GWh totals for commercial battery storage requests (>=MV) on SMARD, while BDEW coordinates the restricted § 9 KraftNAV register for >=100 MW generation and VNBdigital (§ 14e EnWG) hosts DSO Netzausbaupläne and portal links.

checked_pages.saw: Explains EnWG § 17 connection rules, flexible connection agreements (FCA), and KraftNAV without hosting any connection-request register.
Publishes 2024-2026 national TSO and DSO aggregate counts and GW/GWh totals for >=MV battery storage requests and commitments, with no project or node breakdown.

Monitoringbericht Energie 2026 (published 2026-11-23, 324 pp.) notes excessive battery connection requests in the foreword (p. 4) and reports operator structure (4 TSOs + 842 DSOs, p. 97), with no request list.
Joint TSO platform publishes Reifegradverfahren rules and FAQs (effective 2026-04-01), but no consolidated TSO queue table.
Provides address routing to individual DSO portals and § 14d EnWG Netzausbaupläne/Regionalszenarien, not a consolidated connection-request queue.

national_registry.note: Under § 9 KraftNAV, >=110 kV grid operators maintain a joint Kraftwerksanschluss-Register (coordinated via BDEW) covering existing plants and formal connection requests, but it is legally restricted to >=100 MW generation applicants (Anschlussnehmer) and regulatory/supervisory authorities, and since 2025-12-23 excludes all energy storage. For <100 MW plants, storage, demand, and <110 kV distribution grids, no national connection-request registry (public or restricted) exists.

checked_pages.organization: Bundesministerium der Justiz / Gesetze im Internet
checked_pages.saw: Full KraftNAV text as amended 2025-12-23: § 1 excludes storage; § 9 mandates the joint Kraftwerksanschluss-Register for >=100 MW generation and restricts disclosure to Anschlussnehmer and authorities.
Confirms KraftNAV exclusion of storage (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 368) and cites ~650 TSO battery requests (226 GW) at end-2024 alongside MaStR totals, with no public request register.
Public master register of operational and permitted/voluntarily registered 'In Planung' units; § 5 Abs. 4 MaStRV confirms unpermitted connection requests are not registered.
Draft §§ 17a-17f EnWG-E (2026-09-07) mandate monthly capacity maps (§ 17c), bilateral applicant status updates (§ 17d), and DSO applicant portals by 2028 (§ 17e), but no public queue register.
CKAN API searches for 'Netzanschlussbegehren', 'Netzanschlussanfragen', and 'Kraftwerksanschlussregister' returned 0 datasets.

checked_pages.organization: BDEW Bundesverband der Energie- und Wasserwirtschaft
checked_pages.saw: Industry association maintaining the joint § 9 KraftNAV register per DSO disclosures (NRM Netzdienste); exposes no public download or viewer.

if_unstructured.summary: Because current per-request queues are confidential, individual connection requests and commitments can only be reconstructed piecemeal from BNetzA § 31 EnWG dispute decisions, municipal Bebauungsplan / UVP permitting dossiers near substations, and Bundestag parliamentary inquiries (for regional/policy aggregates).
recipe: Collect Beschlusskammer 6 § 31 EnWG PDF rulings from bundesnetzagentur.de ('BK6-25-*', 'BK6-26-*') and extract text with 'pdftotext -layout' to capture named SPVs (whose company names often embed the substation municipality, e.g. 'Alcemi Siedenbrünzow GmbH' -> UW Siedenbrünzow), technology, TSO/DSO, and request/milestone dates from Section I ('Gründe').

Search municipal Bauleitplanung notices and uvp-verbund.de around congested TSO/DSO substations (such as 50Hertz substations with high 'requestedLoadCapacityMw' or 'belegt'/'überbucht' status) for 'Bebauungsplan' + 'Batteriespeicher' / 'Photovoltaik' + 'Netzverknüpfungspunkt' / 'Netzanschlusszusage', and extract developer, hectare/MW figures, target substation, and resolution dates from the Begründung PDF.

Deduplicate redacted § 31 EnWG rulings against municipal B-Plan filings and Handelsregister SPV names, keeping request-stage records ('Netzanschlussbegehren') strictly separate from reserved commitments ('Netzanschlusszusage').
if_unstructured.location_method: Extract parcel numbers (Gemarkung, Flur, Flurstück) and site maps from the municipal Bebauungsplan or UVP Erläuterungsbericht, and match the named Netzverknüpfungspunkt against TSO substation coordinates (e.g. 50Hertz's GetDnbInfo JSON API coordinates).
if_unstructured.cross_with: Cross-check against Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) 'In Planung' units (to see which projects already hold BImSchG permits or voluntary entries), 50Hertz's GetDnbInfo substation 'requestedGenerationCapacityMw' / 'reservedGenerationCapacityMw' totals, and Amprion's 'Kundenprojekte' map.

where_published.name: Bundesnetzagentur Beschlusskammer 6 — Besondere Missbrauchsverfahren nach § 31 EnWG
where_published.what: Published formal decisions on developer complaints against TSOs and DSOs over rejected, delayed, or reprioritized grid connection requests (especially large battery storage).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search bundesnetzagentur.de or Beschlusskammer 6 case folders ('BK6-25-*', 'BK6-26-*') with terms 'Missbrauchsverfahren', 'Netzanschlussbegehren', or 'KraftNAV'; note that exact MW, Bundesland, and queue position are usually redacted as business secrets.

example_document.what_it_gives: Decision BK6-25-298 of 2026-08-05 (pp. 1, 3-7) identifies applicant 'Alcemi Siedenbrünzow GmbH', operator '50Hertz Transmission GmbH', technology 'Batteriespeicher' ('Graustromspeicher') in 'Höchstspannung', initial request '03.01.2025' / 'Mitte März 2025', queue slot notification 'Ende Juni 2025' ('Warteschlangenplatz zugeteilt'), and feasibility advance '14.875,00 Euro', while redacting exact MW and rank.

where_published.name: Municipal Bauleitplanung (Bebauungspläne under BauGB) and UVP-Verbund Environmental Portal
where_published.what: Publicly exhibited land-use plan justifications (Begründungen), early public-participation slides, and EIA reports for utility-scale BESS, solar PV, wind, and industrial projects citing grid connection points or commitments.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Search uvp-verbund.de full text for 'Netzverknüpfungspunkt' or municipal Ratsinformationssysteme / Bauleitplanung pages for 'Sondergebiet Batteriespeicher' + 'Netzanschlusszusage' or 'Umspannwerk'; limitation: covers only projects reaching spatial permitting, not early rejected requests.

example_document.what_it_gives: Gemeinde Wiefelstede B-Plan Nr. 160 'Großbatteriespeicheranlage Conneforde' (2026-10-28, pp. 3-4) documents 'Sonstiges Sondergebiet Großbatteriespeicher' ('ca. 3,94 ha'), node 'UW Conneforde befindet sich auf Höchstspannung', status 'Investor mit positivem Bauvorbescheid und Reservierung für eine Netzanschlusszusage liegt vor', and council resolution date '15.10.2026'.

where_published.name: Deutscher Bundestag — Dokumentations- und Informationssystem für Parlamentsmaterialien (DIP)
where_published.what: Parliamentary Kleine Anfragen, Schriftliche Fragen, and federal bills (Drucksachen) disclosing government statements and occasional regional counts on unapproved or delayed Netzanschlussbegehren.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query dip.bundestag.de or dserver.bundestag.de PDFs for 'Netzanschlussbegehren' or 'Netzanschlussanfragen' filtered to Vorgangstyp 'Kleine Anfrage' / 'Schriftliche Frage'; limitation: yields policy answers or aggregate counts, never project-by-project tables.

example_document.what_it_gives: BT-Drs. 21/1638 (2025-09-12, pp. 1-4, 'Digitalisierung und Bürokratieabbau von Netzanschlüssen') documents 11 parliamentary questions on §§ 14e and 17a-17c EnWG connection portals, capacity maps, and reservation rules across 'über 800 Verteilnetzbetreiber' and the Federal Government's joint response ahead of the 2026 Netzanschlusspaket (BT-Drs. 21/7866).

related_not_answering.name: 50Hertz Digital Grid Capacity Map API & Substation Bay Table (Digitale Netzbilder — Netzkapazität)
related_not_answering.why: Publishes JSON totals per 380/220 kV substation across 75 nodes (59,847 MW requestedGenerationCapacityMw across 48 nodes; 67,712 MW requestedLoadCapacityMw across 51 nodes; 17,770 MW / 12,835 MW reserved; updated through 2026-05-18) plus a PDF bay-congestion list ('nicht überbucht / überbucht / belegt'), not individual connection-request records, projects, technologies, or dates; identical load and generation MW at 40 nodes indicates bidirectional storage is counted in both.

related_not_answering.name: Bundesnetzagentur / SMARD — Stand der Batteriespeicheranfragen 2025/2026
related_not_answering.why: National aggregate data for battery storage, with no project list, node breakdown or non-battery technologies. In 2025 there were 18,158 new requests (573.5 GW / 1,583 GWh). Of those, 1,468 received offers in 2025 (33.9 GW / 98.8 GWh). Including older requests, operators issued 1,937 offers in 2025 (54.2 GW / 142.4 GWh). The TSO update to 2026-04-01 reports 23 requests (6.0 GW) and 64 offers (24.7 GW).

related_not_answering.name: Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) — Planned Units ('In Planung')
related_not_answering.why: Under § 5 Abs. 4 MaStRV, planned power units must register only within one month after federal permitting (BImSchG/WindSeeG) is granted (with optional early registration), omitting unapproved connection requests, demand requests <HV commissioning, queue status, and requested connection nodes (~5.0 GW planned large batteries in MaStR vs 573.5 GW of 2025 connection requests).

related_not_answering.name: Amprion & TransnetBW Grid Connection Possibility Maps (Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten / Netzanschlusskarte)
related_not_answering.why: Amprion's April 2026 PDFs (10 available 380 kV substations for 2032-2035 plus an unlabelled map of substations with active customer projects) and TransnetBW's May 2026 Netzanschlusskarte (hosting-capacity classes <500 MW to 1,500-2,000 MW for 2032/2035) show substation headroom, not connection-request records.

related_not_answering.name: TSO-DSO Cooperation Platform — Capacitypedia Germany
related_not_answering.why: Documents hosting-capacity publication methodologies of the 4 German TSOs and Netze BW (noting an earlier 50Hertz project-number waiting-list practice superseded by the 2026 Reifegradverfahren), but contains no connection-request dataset.

related_not_answering.name: GridChecker — Germany Grid Capacity and Connection Queue
related_not_answering.why: Commercial freemium aggregator tracking substation-level available, reserved, and summed requested MW across 29 German operators (844 sites; 128 GW national queue figure derived by summing 50Hertz's 59.8 GW generation and 67.7 GW demand node totals), with no project-level request records.

related_not_answering.name: Beyond Fossil Fuels / AFRY — European Distribution Grid Backlog Report (June 2026) & RWTH Battery Charts
related_not_answering.why: Beyond Fossil Fuels/AFRY reports national DSO queue estimates for Germany (140 GW renewables and 130 GW battery storage) and RWTH Battery Charts (battery-charts.de) aggregates MaStR installations; neither provides request-level or node-level records.

open_questions: In BNetzA/SMARD's 'Stand der Batteriespeicheranfragen 2025/2026' (17,775 DSO requests / 406.8 GW in 2025), how many of the 813 DSOs participating in Monitoring 2025 operate medium/high-voltage networks and submitted battery-request counts, and are asymmetric battery requests reported by export MW, import MW, or max(export, import)?

In 50Hertz's GetDnbInfo JSON API ('requestedGenerationCapacityMw' = 59,847 MW; 'requestedLoadCapacityMw' = 67,712 MW across 75 substations), which pre-April-2026 waiting-list applications vs 1st-cycle Reifegradverfahren applications are included in 'requested*CapacityMw', and what exact MW share comes from bidirectional battery requests counted identically in both fields at 40 substations?
Whether any of the 4 TSOs will publish anonymized per-cycle request or allocation summaries after completing Phase 3 of the 1st 10-month Reifegradverfahren cycle launched on 2026-04-01.

local_terms.meaning: Formal grid connection request under § 8 EEG, § 17 EnWG, or § 3 Abs. 2 KraftNAV
Grid connection applications/inquiries (term used on TenneT, 50Hertz, and BNetzA battery-survey pages)
Joint operator register of >=100 MW power plants and connection requests at >=110 kV under § 9 KraftNAV
Grid connection commitment reserving capacity at a connection point (distinct from an unapproved request)
Maturity-based TSO connection-allocation procedure launched 2026-04-01 for storage and large loads, replacing first-come-first-served
Grid connection point / substation assigned or assessed for an installation
BNetzA Beschlusskammer 6 dispute proceeding reviewing rejected or delayed grid connection requests
Multiple parallel connection requests filed across nodes/operators for the same project, inflating aggregate queue totals
